entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 473934011733049856: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.8466 +/- 0.0308 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 171.04 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 41.023, -51.299 mas/yr. Radial velocity from No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 473934011733049856 and SIMBAD lists none. entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature

Mass 0.458 +/- 0.011 solar masses from Bernabò et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6383 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..273B/abstract). entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,444 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc588. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,444 K and log g 4.78 (u1 0.171, u2 0.435): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
